tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i lugs kyi sbyin bsreg gi cho ga phrin las rnam rol bzhugs// na mo gu ra we/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i lugs kyi sbyin bsreg gi cho ga phrin las rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo bde mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba yis/ /nyon mongs bud shing bsreg mdzad pa'i/ /'khor lo sdom pa la btud de/ /sbyin bsreg phrin las rnam rol bri/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i gang zag sbyin bsreg gi cho ga byed par 'dod pas dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ rten dang rgyan dgram/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas sa chog rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du song nas/ dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel na gnas khang gi lho/ 'brel na dkyil 'khor gyi lhor ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i sa gzhi star ba la/ khru drug tshad kyis tshangs zur stsal/ /zhi ba'i thab kyi khru gang pa/ /zlum po la ni tshangs pa yi/ /lte bar phur bu drang por bzung / /de nas nyi ma'i sor gyi mthar/ /zlum po'i thig skor pad+ma dang / /thab kyi tshad yin pad ma yi/ /lte ba sum cha kun la mtshungs/ /de yi phyi rol mchu dang ni/ /kha khyer thab kyi bcu gnyis dang / /drug cha'i tshad de sor gnyis dang / /sor bzhi'i mtha' nas legs par bskor/ /kha khyer mtha' nas phyi rol du/ /khru do spangs par rwa ba ni/ /thab kyi dbyibs bzhin bskor bar bya/ /de'ang rwa ba sor gcig dang / /'dod snam sor gnyis pha gu gcig /drwa phyed gnyis min shar bu dang / /mda' yab dag ni re re 'o/ /rwa ba'i brgyad cha sgo yin te/ /rta bab dang bcas byang du 'o/ /slob dpon gdan ni rwa ba'i nang / /tshad dang dbyibs ni thab dang mtshungs/ /thab kyi lho phyogs me lha'i mdun/ /slob dpon gdan gyi pad+ma ni/ /'dab brgyad khru gang tshad ldan te/ /de'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi char/

/mchod yon gzar bu'i gdan dag kyang / /slob dpon gdan ni ji bzhin bri/ /snying por pad+ma'i lte ba dang / gdan rnams dbus su pad dkar bri/ /shar du 'khor lo rin chen lho/ /nub tu rdo rje ral gri byang / /'di dag rigs bzhi'i kha dog can/ /mtshams bzhir snying po'i rnal 'byor ma'i/ /gri gug lha mo'i mdog can bri/ /kha khyer cha lngar phye ba yi/ /dbus kyi cha gsum pad+ma'i phreng / /khyams ni phyogs kyi mdog can te/ /dkar dmar nag po'i rwa ba gsum/ /rta bab mda' yab la sogs pa/ /dkyil 'khor dang mthun sgo gcig pa'o/ /de ltar bris nas bud shing 'o ma can gyi shing ngam/ dgon pa'i ba lang gi lci ba srog chags med pas thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun par rtsigs pa'i dbus su me tshang bca'o/ /yab shing 'o ma can gyi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba sor bcu gnyis pa gas pa dang rul ba la sogs pa'i skyon med pa/ sboms su mthe'u chung gi tshad tsam rtse mo gnyis sbrang rtsi dang mar du myugs shing bdud rtsi dang dri chus gtor ba g.yas phyogs su bzhag de bzhin du mar/ til/ yungs dkar/ chang dang / sha rlon/ bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba'i ril bu/ 'bras chan/ zas mchog ku sha/ dur ba/ nas/ gro/ 'bras/ sran ma/ so ba/ shing tog me tog la sogs pa dang / las thams cad pa'i bsang chu ku sha dang bcas pa rang la nye bar bsham/ g.yon du thod par bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i nang mchod dang / dung dang nya phyis la sogs pa'i snod du dri bzang po dang sbyar ba'i zhabs bsil/ 'o ma dang 'bras spos sbyar ba'i zhal bsil/ me tog dkar po dang bcas pa'i mchod yon/ de dag gi mdun du bzed zhal gyi snod gtsang ma bzhag gzhan yang dri zhim la dkar ba'i me tog ga pur la sogs pa'i spos/ mar dkar gyi mar me/ tsan+dan dkar po dang sbyar ba'i dri chab/ 'o ma dang sbyar ba'i lha bshos/ gtor ma gcig rgyan dang bcas pa bshams te/ thams cad la bdud rtsis gtor la bzhag go

/mdun du rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar la bzhag 'di gnyis thabs shes yin pas ma bral ba bya'o/ /de nas dus gza' zla ba'am/ de'i zhing dang dus sbyor la bab pa'i tshe/ snga dro dang po'am/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel na/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i rjes la/ sgrub pa po lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan zhing gos dang rgyan dkar po can kha byang du phyogs pas/ stan bde ba la pad+ma'i dkyil krung ngam tsog krungs kyis 'dug ste/ mi mthun phyogs mtha' dang zhi bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams bsang chus gtor te las thams cad pas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil la sogs pa rnams dang / yam shing la sogs pa rnams phul/ sa dang bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung ba/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod sprin lta bu/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par mos te/ so so'i sngags dang yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ khyad par du oṃ aḥswāhās yam shing / oṃ ṣ+ṭiṃ swāhās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhās 'bru rnams/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās rdzas gzhan thams cad byin gyis brlabs nas/ suṃ bha ni bzlos shing yam shing la me sbar bas thab la g.yas skor lan gsum byas la/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ zhes pas thab kyi byang phyogs nas me sbar te/ yam shing dang mar dgang blugs gsum gyis kyang gso zhing yi ge bdun la lan gsum bzla'o/ /de bas bsang chu dang las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis thab dang me bsangs shing / swa bha was sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar zhing zlum pa/ kha khyer mu ran dang bcas pa'i dbus su oṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/

raṃ dang pad+ma dkar po las me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum ral pa'i thor tshugs can mchod phyir thogs 'chang ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis na pad dkar dang shel 'phreng / g.yon gnyis na spyi blugs dang dung 'dzin pa/ sku la 'od zer dkar po 'phro bas bsgrub bya'i nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa bsam mo/ /de'i thugs khar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa'i steng du/ raṃ dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam shing / lag pa g.yas pa skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya'i mthe bos srin lag gi rtsa bar g.yab cing / oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i drang srong bram ze mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /chen po 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /badz+ra dha ra ya dz+nya pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes brjod pas mdun du byon pa la/ pad+ma ka ma la satwaṃ/ zhes pas gdan dbul zhing / thab kyi kha khyer la bzhugs pa la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhu tan dz+wa la ya zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i oṃ pra wa ra sad kā raṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhās zhabs bsil/ de bzhin du a tsa ma naṃ gis zhal bsil/ ar+ghaṃ gyis mchod yon rnams pad skor 'gying ba dang bcas pas so so'i phyag rgyas bzed zhal du phul te/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra a na la mahā bhu tan dz+wa la ya sarban bhasmi ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭa/ tri sh+ya dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas dam la bzhag cing / dza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas la/ ku sha dbul ba ni/ las thams cad pa'i bsang ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa gnyis gnyis rang gi g.yon ngos nas brtsams te thab kyi kha khyer la g.yas skor gyis ku sha'i rtse mo phyi ma'i rtsa bas non par dgram zhing / lhag ma ba lang gi rna ba ltar byas pa thab kyi steng nas g.yogs la/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge

/dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /sa la skyes pa'i snying po mchog /bdag cag rnams la bgegs med par mdzod cig swāhā/ zhes brjod do/ /byon zan dbul ba ni/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung nas gru mo gnyis pus mo'i khongs las mi 'da' bar byas la/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hūm̐ dang / me lha'i lce la raṃ bkod de/ oṃ ag+ne ye swāhā zhes pa dang / mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang blugs bkang la/ g.yas bskor gyi me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing / oṃ ag+ne ye ā di bya ā be sha ā be sha ma hā shrī ye/ ha bya ka bya/ bā ha na ya swāhā/ zhes brjod cing dgang blugs kha sbyar ba lan gsum dbul lo/ /de nas me'i ltas brtag ste/ sdom 'byung las/ de nas sngags pas mnyam bzhag cing / /mkhas pas mdog dang sgra dang ni/ /dri dang 'bar ba'i dbyibs brtag ste/ /de bzhin me yi dge mi dge'i/ /mtshan ma nye bar mtshon par bya/ /me ni rtse mo gcig 'bar ba/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad byed/ /rtse mo gnyis ni mi 'khrug pa/ /kun tu 'bar ba 'bring zhes bya/ /rtse mo bzhi ni mnyam 'bar bas/ /rgyas pa'i dngos grub brtan par gnas/ /kun+da zla ba dang mtshungs ma/ /gzugs bzang baiḍur+ya'i 'od/ /dri bral du ba med pa'i me/ /nad med pa dang rigs 'phel byed/ /zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od/ /kha ba yi ni mdog lta bu/ /pus pa ra ga'i mdog mtshungs pa/ /sdig pa thams cad 'jig par byed/ /me tog ban dhu ka mtshungs shing / /dza ba'i me tog dang 'dra ba/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog lta bu/ /dbang phyug rgyal srid rab tu ster/ /tsam pa pad+ma ut+pal dri/ /u shir mā la ti pī ta/ /ga pur a ka ru'i dris/ /dge zhing gnas kyi bdag po mchog /pi wang rgyud mangs rdza rnga dang / /dung dang zangs dung ltar sgra snyan/ /shin du zab pa sgra snyan pa'i/ /me mthong bde ba 'byung bar byed/

/dpal be'u gdugs dang chu skyes dang / /rtse gsum pa dang bum pa'i dbyibs/ /rgyal mtshan rnga yab rdo rje bzang / /g.yung drung rta dang glang po'i dbyibs/ /sgra med g.yas su 'khyil ba dang / /dum bu gcig pa don chen ster/ /'di dag dge ba phun sum tshogs/ /g.yo zhing mdun gyi phyogs su 'bar/ /rtse gsum du ba'i tshogs mang dang / /'khor zhing me stag dang bcas pa/ /rnam par 'phro bas nad 'phel byed/ /me gang yang yang rab tu 'dar/ /yang yang rab tu rgod pa dang / /yang yang g.yon du 'khor ba dang / /yang yang sa la reg byed cing / /thig le nag po sol ba'i mdog /myur du rigs ni zad 'gyur nges/ /gang zhig rgyal po'i drung gnas pa'i/ /sde dang bdag po 'joms par ston/ /mdog ngan du ba'i mdog ltar gnag /mdog ljang sna tshogs mdog rtsub pa/ /pa la sha dang 'bru mar mdog /'dod pa'i don rnams nyams par byed/ /ro dri nya'i dri ltar ngan/ /chu skyes srog chags dri dang ldan/ /gal te me ni 'di ltar gyur/ /gtso bo rnam par ltung bar byed/ /tsa ḍa tsa ḍa zhes sgra dang / /tshaṃ tshaṃ zhes pa'i sgra dang ldan/ /siṃ siṃ gyi ni sgra bdag nyid/ /rdo rje'i sgra ni don nyams byed/ /mdung dang ral gri mda' dang sbrul/ /rnga mo ba lang mgo lta bu/ /'jigs rung rnam pa gang de mthong / /dgang blugs gsum dang bdun byin te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mi shes pa'i mtshan ma byung zhing bgegs dang bcas par shes na/ las thams cad pa bzlas zhing / bsang chus me la bsang gtor byas la bsrung / las thams cad pa'i sngags la che ge mo'i bgegs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes btags pas/ mar dgang blugs bdun dbul lo/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra a na la sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe aḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes sogs/ oṃ dang swāhā'i bar du chud pa'i mchod sngags so sos rol mo'i bar gyis mchod la/ nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/

'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs te/ dbul ba'i tshul la/ gzhung las mar dang til la rdzas sngags logs su gsungs la/ gzhan thams cad oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū tan dz+wa la ya sarba bhisma ku ru/ sarba bigha nan hūm̐ phaṭa/ a mu ka s+ya shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes dbul bar bshad cing / rgyas pa la spro na/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la ya'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ya che ge mo'i sarba pa paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes sogs kyi spel tshig sde tshan re re'i thog mthar btags la/ yam shing byang chub shing du mos nas 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la dbul/ de bzhin du sbyar te oṃ ag+ne ye swāhās mar dang / oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya sarba pā paṃ shin+taṃ ku ru swāhās til dang / oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dha ye swāhā yungs dkar dang / me lha'i sngags kyis bcu pa dang / oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhās zas mchog dang / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swāhās ku sha gdan du dbul/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhās dur ba dbu'i gtsug tu dbul/ oṃ mahā be gā ya swāhās nas dang / oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swāhās gro dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swāhās 'bras dang 'bras chan/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swāhās sran ma dang / oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swāhās so ba dang / oṃ aḥs ma dhi pha la ya swāhās shing thog dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swāhās me tog rnams nyi shu rtsa gcig re dbul lo/ /sde tshan re re'i 'jug tu'ang / sbyin pa'i bdag po dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ nad dang gdon dang bgegs dang bar du gcod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/

zhes sogs dang / bla ma'i ched du yin na/ bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā zhes dang / dus las 'das pa'i ched du yin na che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa sa dang lam gyi bar du gcod pa shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes sogs ji ltar rigs pa'i spel tshig sbyar bar bya ste/ yam shing dang mar gyi rjes su sdig pa zhi ba la til gtso bor dbul zhing / tshe ring ba'i don du dur ba dbul/ rdzas gzhan ma 'byor na med kyang chog gsung / des gzhan la'ang 'gre'o/ /de dag kyang zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal dang / gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag tu dbul lo/ /slar yang snga ma ltar phyi nang gis mchod cing bstod de/ bsang chus gtor nas/ hūm̐ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam te 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i phyir me bsangs shing sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba dang drwa ba gur bla re mda'i drwa ba ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas go cha bcing ba'i bar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa sgrub thabs ltar sgra tshul las bskyed pa/ spos dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes sogs sam/ yang oṃ badz+ra he ru ka e h+ye hi bha ga wan/ i ha wā kya sa ma y+yen+na tsa pañtsa a mri ta/ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tshi pū dzaṃ pra sā dha yā mi/ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs la dgug gzhug bcing mnyes par bya/ dbang bskur te rgyas btab nas sngags dang phyi dang yid las byung ba dang / nang dang mnyes pa dang / bla na med pa'i bar gyi mchod nas rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod la/

dgang blugs kyi kha dang lha'i ljags la hūm̐ bsams te/ gtso bo'i snying po lan re dang / oṃ ag+ne ya swāhā zhes pa bdun bdun gyis rkang pa'i dgang blugs kha sbyar ba lan gsum/ oṃ ag+ne ye di bya zhes pa la sogs pas snga ma ltar byon zan dbul lo/ /de nas yaṃ shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams bsangs shing sbyangs la byin gyis brlabs te/ sde tshan re re'i thog ma dang tha mar snying po nyid la so so'i rdzas sngags dang spel tshig btags la bar du snying po dang rdzas re spel ba nyer gcig nas stong gi bar ci nus pa dbul zhing / nang mchod kyi mchod/ yi ge bdun pas dgang blugs gsum phul bas phrin las mdzad par bsams te/ gtso bo'i mdun du oṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zla ba'i gdan la sgrub bya bsams nas/ dum skyes ma dkar mo phyag g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ka g.yas na hūm̐ las byung ba'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib dang nad gdon la sogs pa zhi bar bsam mo/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma nas gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar gyi sngags la spel tshig btags pa'i yam shing la sogs pa bdun bdun dbul/ rdzogs pa'i mthar yi ge bdun pas dgang blugs bdun dbul zhing snga ma ltar mchod pa rgyas pas mchod nas rol mo 'byor tshad dkrol zhing me tog gtor la/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung zhing / /zhes sogs shis pa rgyas par brjod/ slar yang bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bstod la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad zhi ba la sogs pa ci 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab cing yi ge brgya pa brjod pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs dang / bdag cag las dang po par gyur pas yo byad ma 'byor ba dang / ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa la sogs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad/

mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol zhes brjod de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus la/ snam lnga 'dod pa'i skor ba'i phyag rgya mthar 'khyud pa'i tshul bya ste/ oṃ yo ga shud dho'i sngags brjod de dngos gzhi'o/ /mjug du thab dang rdzas rnams bsangs la me lha'i sngags kyi mthar blugs gzar gang gis me gso ste/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha skad cig gis gsal btab nas/ bsreg rdzas kyi lhag ma rnams bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pas phul la/ slar yang mar dgang blugs bdun gshegs skyems kyi tshul du phul nas/ phyi dang nang gis mchod cing bstod la byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhu tan dz+wa la ya'i mthar/ a ka ro sbyar ba lan gsum gyis dbul/ slar yang sngar bzhin mchod de/ tshangs dbang 'jig rten mchog gi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs la skyabs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa/ /rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /skal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rigs sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi bcud ldan 'gun dhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba mnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod de/ drang srong chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes te/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyi phrin las bcol la/ mjug tu'ang mchod yon phul te/ ci 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang / zhes pa la sogs pas bzod par gsol nas/

bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrubs kyis bzhud gcig byin za khyod/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrub/ /oṃ ag+ne ye gats+tsha/ zhes pas spyan drangs ba'i phyag rgya las mthe bo phyir bskyed de ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus nas/ rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /zhes sogs kyi dge ba bsngos la/ ji ltar rigs pa'i smon lam dang bkra shis brjod par bya'o/ /de nyid du mngon rtogs bsgoms pa yin na bdag bskyed bsdus te/ bdag nyid go cha gsum dang tshang ngam sngags kyis kyang bsrungs la/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis langs te spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o/ /long yod na me ma shi bar du mi 'gul bar bzhag long med na 'o mas me bzhil la rdul tshon dang thal ba rnams bsdus nas las thams cad pa'i bum par blugs te rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor dor nas las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /de ltar zhi ba'i cho ga zhib tu bshad nas/ rgyas pa'i khyad par bstan pa ni/ thab khung khru do pa gru bzhi ser po lte bar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa mchu sor bzhi kha khyer sogs brgyad pa bri/ slob dpon gyi gdan lho nub tu bya/ sgo byang shar du bstan/ brtsigs pa'am brus pa la ni rang rang gi rgya'i phyed dpangs yin la phyi dbyibs gru bzhir bya/ bud shing 'o ma can gyi dbus kyi cha las byung ba'i shing / yam shing khru gang pa sboms su mthe bo'i tshad/ zho dang mar du myugs pa dngar gsum gyis sbags pa dri ser pos bsangs/ mchod yon gyi snod gser dngul du til dang zho dang sbyar ba'i mchod yon zho zan gyi lha bshos dang gtor ma/ slob dpon gyis gos dang rgyan dkar ser gdags/ byang shar du phyogs pas/ stan thon po la bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyi 'dug ste dga' zhing mgu ba'i bsam pas bya/ rgyas pa la gza' nyi ma dang snga gro/

dge 'dun gyi spro khang gi mes byang shar nas sbar/ me lha dkar ser g.yas 'khor lo dang mu tig gi phreng ba g.yon pad+ma dang phyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gzhung du zhi rgyas la rigs bdag ma gsungs kyang / gzhan rnams dus 'khor dang mthun pas 'dir yang snang ba mtha' yas dkar po sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan par bzhed do/ /me lha'i thugs khar me'i dkyil 'khor la raṃ ser po/ spel tshig che ge mo'i tshe dang bsod nams puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes brjod/ phrin las kyi dmigs pa ni lam las dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor la glang po che'i steng du sgrub bya bzhag ste/ dum skyes ma ser mo g.yas rin po che bsnams pas nor gyi char phab par bsam mo/ /bsreg rdzas spyir zas mchog gtso bor dbul zhing / khyad par du 'byor pa rgyas pa la mar/ gzi brjid rgyas pa la yam shing / lhag par dpa' ba la bud shing / srung ba la ku sha tshe rgyas pa la dur wa/ spyir rgyas pa la 'bras/ sdig pa zhi ba la yungs dkar/ nor dang 'bru dgug pa la so ba/ stobs 'phel ba la sran ma/ rlung gi shugs ster ba la nas/ nad 'joms pa la gro/ shes rab 'phel ba la 'o zho sbrang rtsi/ bde ba rgyas pa la zho zan gtso bor dbul lo/ /gsol gdab/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa dang / che ge mo'i tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang grags pa dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ gzhan grangs la sogs pa lhag ma rnams ni sngar bstan pa bzhin du bya'o/ /'khor lo bde mchog gi sbyin bsreg gi tshul rgyas par shes par 'dod pa rnams kyi ni slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gzhung gi don bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches gsal bar mdzad pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /de yang lū hi pa'i khyad par gyi chos/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha sgra tshul las bskyed par shes par bya'o/

/blo dman rnams kyis rtogs sla'i phyir/ /zhi rgyas sbyin bsreg mdor bsdus tsam/ /logs su bkol la nongs pa gang / /mkhas dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags/ /phrin las rnam rol nyin mor byed/ /brtsams pa'i dge ba tsha zer gyis/ /mtha' yas 'gro blo'i mun gsal nas/ /ye shes pad+ma rgyas gyur cig /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i las chen bcu gnyis kyi sbyin bsreg gi cho ga grub thob chen po lū hi pa'i dngos kyi slob ma/ slob dpon dha ri ka pas dus kyi 'khor lo dang cha mthun par mdzad pa las zhi rgyas kyi sbyin bsreg tsam lag tu blang ba'i tshul mdor bsdus te rgyas par bstan pa 'di ni/ don du gnyer ba rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpa' bo'i lo sa ga'i zla ba la dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lha rtse ba bu ston chos rgyal gyis bgyis so/ /'dis bstan pa dang sems can mang po la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' bkra shis/ dpal bde mchog lū hi pa'i lugs kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
